name: Shashijit Infraprojects Limited
summary: Shashijit Infraprojects Ltd. undertakes the construction and advancement of diverse projects, spanning critical infrastructure, private driveways, public utility networks, power facilities, industrial factories, and various fixed real estate properties. Its operations are organized into two primary divisions: the development of immovable private assets and engagement in governmental infrastructure works. Founded in 1991, the company's main office is situated in Vapi, India.
